rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for both cookies and crackers.

example.english: I bought a biscuit and put it in the drawer.
example.traditional: 我買咗塊餅乾放咗喺櫃桶入面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 faai3 beng2 gon1 fong3 zo2 hai2 gwai6 tung2 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this specifically for sweet Western-style cookies, especially when distinguishing them from crackers.

example.english: This biscuit is sweet and smells great.
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 kuk1 kei4 tim4 tim4 dei2 hou2 hoeng1

rows.note: Use this for the dry, usually salty soda-cracker type rather than crackers in general.

example.english: Have a soda biscuit first to tide you over.
example.jyutping: sik6 faai3 so1 daa2 beng2 sin1 ding2 tou5 laa1
